## 🚩 Revolutionary Idea / Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what the feature is and why the Party needs it. 

## 🎯 The Purpose / Problem it Solves
What issue or friction does this feature eliminate? Explain how it benefits our Comrades.

## 🛠 Proposed Solution / Implementation Strategy
Any ideas on how we can implement this? Mention specific frontend components, assets, or backend logic if you have something in mind.

## 🎨 Design / Visual Context (If Applicable)
Add any screenshots, wireframes, or reference UI mockups here to guide the design layout.

## 📜 Party Alignment Check
- [ ] This feature directly upgrades the public user experience.
- [ ] I am ready to work on this if approved by the Core Committee.
